Widget.name: 3D Map
Widget.noWebGL: This map needs WebGL, which this browser does not offer.

Settings.styleUrlHint: A MapLibre style. The default, OpenFreeMap Liberty, is free and needs no key.
Settings.darkStyleUrl: Style in the dark theme (empty: the same)
Settings.rasterUrlHint: An XYZ template ({z}/{x}/{y}). A WMS server is added below as a service.
Settings.rasterInvertDark: Turn the raster base dark in the dark theme
Settings.wmsFailed: This address answers no WMS GetCapabilities.
Settings.attribution: Attribution of the whole map (empty: the one of the style and the raster base)
Settings.attributionHint: Replaces the whole attribution. The attribution the licence of the map data asks for (e.g. © OpenStreetMap contributors) must stay visible. Links are allowed.
Settings.attributionCompact: Fold the attribution behind an i button
Settings.interactive: Users can move, tilt and turn the map
Settings.buildingSourceLayer: Layer of the buildings in the style
Settings.terrainUrlHint: A TileJSON, or elevation tiles with {z}/{x}/{y}.
Settings.widgetSource: The data source of the widget
Settings.thingNamesHint: x* starts with, *x ends with, *x* contains. Only these things are loaded.
Settings.colorSuffix: Datastream of the colour (end of its id)
Settings.colorSuffixHint: Its latest value picks the colour below.
Settings.markerIconHint: A Material Symbols icon, e.g. sensors. Empty: a white dot.
Settings.heightSuffix: Datastream of the height (end of its id)
Settings.refreshSeconds: Read the latest values every (s, 0: once)
Settings.geoJson: GeoJSON (written in, wins over the address)

models.urlHint: The server of the file must allow the board to read it (CORS).
models.placeHint: In the preview: a click adds the model, drag moves it, a right click removes it.

errors.blocked: The file cannot be read: the server does not allow it (no CORS header) or cannot be reached.
errors.http: The server answered with an error ({{status}}).
errors.format: The file is no model in this format.

MapLibreSettings.modelLayers: Symbol layers of the map: a 3D model at every point of a data source, or placed by hand.

ColorMapping.code: The value as the field or the datastream gives it, e.g. RED.
ColorMapping.color: The colour it gives, any CSS colour.

ModelLayer.name: Name of the layer, as a user knows it.
ModelLayer.url: Address of the model file. The server must allow the board to read it (CORS).
ModelLayer.format: The format of the file: fbx, gltf (also glb), or empty to tell it by the ending of the address.
ModelLayer.scale: Metres per unit of the model. A file in centimetres (most FBX files) takes 0.01.
ModelLayer.rotation: Rotation of the model around the vertical, in degrees clockwise from north.
ModelLayer.altitudeOffset: Height above the ground, in metres.
ModelLayer.datasourceId: A data source of points (e.g. a WFS tree cadastre): a model stands at every point, besides the instances placed by hand. Empty: only those.
ModelLayer.transforms: Steps on the points before they are drawn - filter, or extract a part of a field, e.g. the genus as the first word of a species.
ModelLayer.size: How tall and how wide a model is, from fields of its point.
ModelLayer.color: The colour of the model, from a field of its point; the parts named in parts have their own.
ModelLayer.modelBy: Which model file a point gets, by a field of its point. Without it, the file above.
ModelLayer.parts: Meshes of the model that have colours of their own, e.g. the trunk of a tree.

SizeEncoding.height: How tall the model is, in metres; the model is scaled to it.
SizeEncoding.width: How wide the model is, in metres; the model is scaled across to it. Without it, across in proportion to the height.

FieldEncoding.field: The field of the point. Empty: every point has the value below.
FieldEncoding.unit: The unit of the field: m, cm, mm or km. Empty: the unit of its column type, else m.
FieldEncoding.scaleType: identity: the value in metres as it is; linear: the domain below maps to the range below.
FieldEncoding.domainMin: linear: the smallest value of the field.
FieldEncoding.domainMax: linear: the largest value of the field.
FieldEncoding.rangeMin: linear: the metres the smallest value gives.
FieldEncoding.rangeMax: linear: the metres the largest value gives.
FieldEncoding.value: The metres where the field has no value; 0: the scale of the model.

ColorEncoding.field: The field of the point. Empty: every point has the colour below.
ColorEncoding.type: nominal: a colour per value (mappings); quantitative: the ramp from lowColor to highColor.
ColorEncoding.mappings: nominal: which value gives which colour.
ColorEncoding.lowColor: quantitative: the colour of the low end.
ColorEncoding.highColor: quantitative: the colour of the high end.
ColorEncoding.color: The colour where no value gives one. Empty: the colours of the file.

PartEncoding.mesh: Which meshes: a regular expression on their names (and the names of their materials), case ignored, e.g. trunk|stem|cylinder.

ModelInstance.scale: Size of this one, as a factor on the scale of the layer.
ModelInstance.rotation: Rotation of this one, in degrees, added to the rotation of the layer.
